what_i_did: Researched Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.49 specifications and documentation
Analyzed AXS15231B display controller datasheet and integration requirements
Identified V1 vs V2 board differences and GPIO pin mapping changes
Created comprehensive embedded development guide for the display
Provided sample ESP-IDF code for initialization and touch handling
Compiled troubleshooting resources and debugging techniques
Listed official and community documentation sources

version_differences.v1_discontinued: Ships switched to V2 after June 8, 2026
version_differences.v2_identification: Rev1.1 silkscreen on PCB, V2 QC sticker on case

sample_code_provided: I2C touch controller setup and interrupt handling

files_created.description: Comprehensive development guide covering all 5 requested areas

issues_encountered: Limited public documentation for AXS15231B controller (only preliminary datasheet available)
No exact V1/V2 GPIO pinout documented in a single source - compiled from multiple resources
Community issues show common problems with initialization sequences that were addressed in the guide
Some forum posts indicate display static issues with incorrect QSPI configurations
key_recommendations: Use ESP-IDF v5.5.3 or compatible version
Always verify V1 vs V2 before flashing firmware (wrong backlight pin = no backlight)
Start QSPI clock at 10MHz, increase only if stable
Use TCA9554 GPIO expander carefully - toggling pin 1 can disable backlight on some revisions
Consider using LVGL v8.4.0 for most stable driver support
Always verify PSRAM initialization before display init
